name: Roster
tagline: Keeps a roster of your people, bots and projects, and flags who has gone quiet.
description: You hand it the list of people, assistants, projects and tools you actually keep track of, and it maintains that roster and tells you who has gone quiet on what - without inventing names that were not on your list.
author: Saint_Chevalier
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
